# Leave Policy

The company offers 25 days of annual leave per year for all full-time employees.
Employees may carry over up to 5 unused days into the following year.
Parental leave is 16 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers.
Sick leave is uncapped but requires a doctor's certificate after 5 consecutive days.

Effective date: 2025-01-15
Approved by: CHRO
